description: Manages the retrieval of posted partner tree structures, representing organizational hierarchies or relationships.

endpoints.name: GetPostedPartnerTrees
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all posted partner tree structures available in the system.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all available partner trees?
Show me all the organizational hierarchies that have been published.
I need to see a comprehensive list of all posted partner structures.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to view or process all available partner tree structures without specifying a particular one.

endpoints.name: GetPostedPartnerTree
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific posted partner tree structure by its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the partner tree to retrieve.

example_uses: Can you fetch the partner tree with ID 123?
I want to see the details of the organizational hierarchy identified by 456.
Retrieve the specific posted partner structure that has the ID 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to retrieve the details of a single, specific partner tree structure, and you know its unique ID.
